title: Projection-balanced ordinary quotient of an integral Tate tensor
statement: Let T be a Noetherian scheme, ell a prime invertible on T, and n,d natural numbers. Using the actual completed root tensor and quotientLine of [def-pur-condensed-tate-integral-tower-data], there is a sheaf isomorphism from realization T ell n of finiteSheaf T ell n d to quotientLine T ell n d satisfying ProjectionBalanced, with all local quotient scalars and every compatible root lift. This makes no derived or tower assertion.

source.place: Step 1: ordinary quotient balancing and its root-projection formula of lem-pur-normalized-tate-tensor-reductions

proof.text: Obtain a morphism with the root-generator formula from lem-pur-tate-tensor-generator-map. Apply lem-pur-tate-tensor-generator-isiso to promote it to an isomorphism. Extend the generator formula to arbitrary scalars by linearity of the morphism and the scalar balancing identity for the sheafified extension tensor.

proof_origin.place: Ordinary quotient map, local invertibility, and scalar linearity

Mathlib has no matching project predicates. The project has the parent NormalizedTateTensorTowerCore, its assembled parent and the separate constructibility and zero clauses. QuotientRootLineComparison already proves existence of normalized finite comparisons and is reused. OrdinaryLineDerivedScalarComparison is general line/scalar theory but does not identify these actual integral projections or construct this strict ordinary quotient tower.

lean.statement:
theorem tateTensorQuotient_balancing
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    (hT : IsUnit (ell : Γ(T, ⊤))) (n d : ℕ) :
    ∃ b : (realization T ell n).obj (finiteSheaf T ell n d) ≅ quotientLine T ell n d,
      ProjectionBalanced T ell n d b
